title: Sordland/Turn06/InT_2ndCompanyChoice
description: This conversation is available if the President has chosen to build the H-3 Highway. The intracies of this project is that it strengthens Lileas Graf's political connection Eric Niel the mayor of Arvory. Also the S.S.C. company. It avoids Laren and other villages away from the coast thus not fixing the infrastructure situation entirely. The advantages are heightened trade with Agnolia and more business investment in the region. This will lift people out of poverty. Symon Holl is neutral in his advocation. There is a choice between giving the contract and then the project responsibility to Symon or Lileas Graf.
